Name: Trick or Treat Bushes
Author: maerumaer2u
Description:
This mod was created for the 2023 Great Stardew Mod-Off

During the last week of Fall (Fall 22 - 28), you'll find decorated bushes all throughout the valley.  When you shake off the items they hold, will you get a trick...or a treat?

There are four possible variants, each with a 20% chance to appear.

[b]If you use Simple Foliage:[/b]
[spoiler] Simply open the assets folder, delete the 'spiderwebs.png' asset, and rename 'spiderwebs_SF.png [/spoiler]

[b]If you're curious what each variant yields:[/b]
[spoiler] Jack-O-Lantern﻿ String Light bushes drop Jack-O-Lanterns
Skull String Light bushes drop Bone Fragments
Sheet Ghost bushes drop Solar Essence
Spider Web bushes drop Slime [/spoiler]

A big thanks to the Great Stardew Mod-Off organizers for their patience and support!
